title: Expired One-Word Domains: a sample of 1,000 names with status and prices
description:
1,000 one-word domain names whose registration has expired, each with its status, prices when known, two coarse bands, the word's length, a registrar and, on a few rows, the registration and expiry dates. Each word exists once on each ending: when a registration is not renewed, that word may come back on that ending, once.

The files are expired.csv and expired.json. The GitHub repository refreshes them every night, and this record holds them as they were on the day of its release, so a study of which names come back can be reproduced and cited. The list of the day is at https://unique.domains/domains/expired.

The Unique.domains API serves the same rows at GET https://api.unique.domains/v1/domains?status=expired, with no key. Documentation: https://unique.domains/api.
